messages:
alex: Heads up — planning a coordinated deploy Tue 03:00 UTC. API -> v2.4.0, runtime -> v1.9.0-quant, console UI patch, router routing rules bump. Need dependency matrix and pins before the window.

morgan: +1. change window OK from my side. timeline?

alex: Plan: 03:00 start, 03:00-03:20 api canary (5/25/50), 03:20 runtime rollout, 03:40 console switches, 04:00 full router traffic shift. Buffer until 05:00.

sara: I can own runtime rollout and quant smoke. Will run perf harness beforehand at 02:15. If p95 latency +15% then stop.

tim: I'll own API canary. Need to pin model versions in router policy before traffic shift. Also will run schema-compat check. Command I use: `./scripts/canary-check --service api --version v2.4.0`

janet: Console patch is purely UI; no DB migrations. Will feature-flag behind `console.new-search` and flip at 03:40.

alex: Important: router must support immediate pin to previous variant. Rollback trigger: any SLO breach (>=5% errors or p95 spike >20% baseline) or Canary failures.

depict: (reacted :eyes:)

deploy-bot: api-ci pipeline started for api@v2.4.0 — build ci-3456 queued.

infra-bot: Reserved capacity: dedicated-pool-3 -> 4 GPUs reserved from 02:45-05:15.

morgan: For pinning, let's use the router policy below — please confirm values before I apply:
```json
{
  "service": "api",
  "pinned_version": "v2.3.1",
  "canary_routes": [{"version":"v2.4.0","weight":5},{"version":"v2.4.0","weight":25},{"version":"v2.4.0","weight":50}],
  "rollback_on_errors_pct": 5
}
```

sara: That looks good. For runtime, I'll publish quant profile `q8_1` and keep `q8_1` disabled until after canary passes.

tim: I'll create the preflight checklist and post a link: https://internal.redwood/prod-deploys/1782456789-preflight (will add test runs).

alex: Owners: api=tim, runtime=sara, console=janet, router=morgan. Oncall during window: @morgan (primary), @alex (secondary).

morgan: I'll run a dry-run of the routing pin locally now. Expect to push router policy at 02:55 UTC.

janet: Console rollout note — CDN invalidation may take ~3-5m. Account for that before flipping feature flag.

sara: Runtime rollback snippet (tested):
```bash
# rollback runtime to previous packaging
./deploy/runtime_deploy.sh --version v1.8.0 --pool dedicated-pool-3 --confirm
```

alex: Quick checklist: CI green for all services, preflight perf ok, capacity reserved, router pin ready, rollback scripts uploaded, oncall notified. If any item fails, we stop and reschedule.

tim: Added two smoke prompts to the canary set. If generation quality dip >2 points on eval set, abort.

deploy-bot: api-ci ci-3456 passed unit tests; integration queued.

infra-bot: Monitoring dashboards cloned: /dashboards/1782456789-deploy (latency, errors, infra load).

morgan: I'll post the final pin command in the thread 15m before window and ping owners. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — please react with :white_check_mark: when you've applied your prep items so we can start on time.

janet: Reacted :white_check_mark:.

sara: Reacted :white_check_mark:.

tim: Reacted :white_check_mark:.

morgan: Reacted :white_check_mark:.

alex: See you all in the window. If anything shows up before 02:00 UTC ping me directly.
